title: Epictetus — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Epictetus's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

sections.heading: Where he can't see

pieces.title: Pressed from five sides
pieces.caption: Half of Epictetus's ten links are contradictions. The page's text names one of the five, Marcus Aurelius. The other four are held only in the links: Lao Tzu, Martin Buber and Martin Heidegger from this page, and Seneca from Seneca's. *What is real and what is a choice:* All ten links that touch Epictetus in the map build of 2026-11-09, none left out. Five 'contradicts' is level with Martin Heidegger, the most among the 25 person pages. The small words are each link's own label with the hyphens taken out. Which side each group sits on, and the order down each side, are the maker's. 'Pressed' is the page's word ('Press him'); a contradiction here is a tension kept, not an enmity. *Leaking in:* Seneca, whose page declares the contradiction 'wealthy-statesman-vs-dispossessed-slave'; and Marcus Aurelius, whose forward vector says 'a slave-philosopher or a systems-thinker will ask whether my calm is wisdom or privilege'.

challenge.by: challenger · light round, batch E (sheets from heroes, avatars and records) · read-only dispatch

verdicts.why: The five red links are real, but the ratio is tilted and the footer is broken. (1) The footer prints "5 of his 8 named links are 'contradicts' (the most among the people is Epictetus, with 5)". That is the code's fall-through for a tie: he does not have more than any other person, he is level with Martin Heidegger at five. Say so.

remade.what: Two labelled links were dropped (one of them the page's own root, The Dichotomy of Control), the footer printed a broken sentence for the tie with Heidegger, and a red line struck through 'Lao Tzu'. All ten links are drawn in two columns with their labels beside them, the tie is stated, and the title no longer reads a contradiction as a quarrel (was 'Against the room'; file name kept).
remade.by: a dispatched workshop maker, a child, from the challenger's report; looked over by the working session; placed by the Concierge
